risk_assessment.risk_factor: Real wage stagnation / consumer demand erosion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour dividend-paying defensives (CBA, CSL, WES); reduce discretionary consumer exposure; monitor retail sales and CPI data

risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor cross-border capital flows; Australian property developers face demand risk if US policy triggers global risk-off

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: ACCC regulatory threat, tenant relief policy, and potential Trump-driven housing demand shock create overhang

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD exposure in international portfolios
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD crushed post-Fed; further depreciation likely if RBA lags Fed; miners benefit but non-mining exporters suffer

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to consolidate near recent highs with bank-led gains offset by REIT and small-cap weakness. RBA rate-hike expectations and oil at $100 provide support, but AUD weakness and IMF fiscal warnings cap upside. Volatility elevated around Fed/RBA policy divergence.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA mining pipeline, AI infrastructure buildout, and energy transition support 6-12 month ASX upside. However, IMF-mandated fiscal austerity, real wage stagnation, and potential housing correction pose headwinds. Index likely range-bound with sector rotation favouring financials and materials over consumer and property.
